FEDERAL DEPOSIT INSURANCE CORPORATION


Sunshine Act Meetings: Notice of Meeting To Be Held With Less 
Than Seven Days' Advance Notice

TIME AND DATE: 10:00 a.m. on September 17, 2026.

PLACE: This Board meeting will be open to public observation by 
webcast. Visit <a href="https://www.fdic.gov/news/board-matters/video.html">https://www.fdic.gov/news/board-matters/video.html</a> for a 
link to the webcast. Members of the media should contact the Office of 
Communications by Wednesday, September 16, 2026, at 
<a href="/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection#0a676f6e636b786f7b7f6f797e794a6c6e6369246d657c"><span class="__cf_email__" data-cfemail="ea878f8e838b988f9b9f8f999e99aa8c8e8389c48d859c">[email&#160;protected]</span></a> to attend in person. FDIC Board Members and 
staff will participate from FDIC

[[Page 58899]]

Headquarters, 550 17th Street NW, Washington, DC.
    Observers requiring auxiliary aids should email 
<a href="/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection#3c78554f5d5e55505548456c4e535b4e5d517c5a58555f125b534a"><span class="__cf_email__" data-cfemail="c783aeb4a6a5aeabaeb3be97b5a8a0b5a6aa87a1a3aea4e9a0a8b1">[email&#160;protected]</span></a> to make necessary arrangements.

STATUS: Open to public observation via webcast.

MATTERS TO BE CONSIDERED: The Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation's 
(FDIC) Board of Directors will meet to consider the following matters:

Discussion Agenda

    Notice of Proposed Rulemaking: Merger Transactions.
    Notice of Proposed Rulemaking: State Bank Parity.

Summary Agenda

    No substantive discussion of the following item is anticipated. The 
Board of Directors will resolve this matter with a vote unless a member 
of the Board requests that this item be moved to the discussion agenda.
    Rescission of Board Statement on the Development and Communication 
of Supervisory Recommendations.

CONTACT PERSON FOR MORE INFORMATION: For further information, please 
contact Hanoi Veras, Executive Secretary, FDIC, at 
<a href="/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection#b9fffdf0fafbd6d8cbddf4d8cdcddccbcaf9dfddd0da97ded6cf"><span class="__cf_email__" data-cfemail="1553515c56577a746771587461617067665573717c763b727a63">[email&#160;protected]</span></a>.
    Authority: 5 U.S.C. 552b.

    Dated at Washington, DC, on September 15, 2026.
Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation.

Hanoi Veras,
Executive Secretary.
